video.title: AWS Essentials: The Top 5 Cloud Services You Need to Know

transcript.text: five AWS Services you should learn today
number one is Amazon ec2 Amazon ec2 is a
compute service in AWS that lets you
create virtual Machines of different
operating systems in the cloud you can
use Amazon ec2 service for a variety of
workloads like deploying database
hosting your website running a big data
application and much more number two is
going to be Amazon S3 Amazon S3 is a
managed storage service in AWS that can
be used to store unlimited amount of
data you can use S3 to store any kind of
data like videos code images songs
anything S3 is known for durability and
its cost Effectiveness number three is
Amazon RDS Amazon RDS is a managed
database service which makes it easy to
set up operate and scale a relational
database in the cloud RDS supports
various popular database engines like
MySQL postgresql and Oracle number four
is AWS Lambda Lambda is a serverless
Computing service that allows you to run
code in response to events without
managing any servers Lambda supports
variety of programming languages like
python node.js Ruby and much more Lambda
can be used plenty of workloads from
building serverless web applications to
processing data streams number fifth is
going to be Amazon Cloud watch
cloudwatch is used to monitor metrics
logs and events also to set alarms and
automate responses Whenever there is an
issue
